intl.title: FAU - International students: how to apply

iei.title: FAU Intensive English Institute - Academic Track / Global Academic Track

test_policy.notes: Required by Florida Board of Governors rule for all Florida public universities: first-year applicants must submit an SAT, ACT or CLT score (ACT Science no longer needed from the 2025-26 cycle). Middle 50% of admitted first-years: SAT 1090-1270, ACT 22-28, GPA 3.66-4.29 (recalculated on academic core courses). Students admitted without scores are not eligible for merit scholarships.

requirements.notes: International applicants apply through the Common App with a $30 non-refundable fee. High school records from non-U.S. curricula must be evaluated by a NACES agency (course-by-course list, overall U.S. GPA and a separate math GPA). 18 high school units (4 English, 4 math, 3 science, 3 social science, 2 foreign language, 2 electives). Essays and recommendations are not mentioned on these pages.

deadlines.label: Early Action application deadline (summer/fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Dates print without a year; treated as fall 2027 entry. Materials due Oct 22, last scores considered Nov 20; outcomes are admit, defer or deny. Nursing BSN direct admit and Pre-Architecture also use Oct 15 (complete by Jan 15).

deadlines.label: Rolling Decision application and materials deadline (summer/fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Decisions are issued about four weeks after the file is complete (International deadlines page). Outcomes: admit, defer, deny or waitlist. FAU may offer a different entry term than requested.

deadlines.label: Freshman merit scholarship automatic consideration; President's International Scholarship priority
deadlines.notes: International President's Scholarship ($6,000) priority deadline Jan 15, regular Mar 15 for fall.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if SAT EBRW is at least 490 or ACT Reading 19 and English 17 (Florida BOG college-readiness minimums), or with 3 years of secondary education in English-medium instruction (U.S. or abroad, or in a majority-English country), 30 post-secondary credits including ENC 1101/1102 with C or better, or 60+ post-secondary credits. Also accepted: HKDSE 5, IGCSE English C/4, IB English HL 6, ELS 112, OHLA Elite, Study Group 65%, FAU Intensive English Institute Level VI. Below the minimum: the Conditional Admissions Track (CAT) lets students complete the FAU Intensive English Institute's Global Academic Track (Level 6) instead of submitting TOEFL or IELTS.

english.notes: The page prints 'iBT (4.5)/PBT (550)'; 4.5 is read as the new 1-6 scale. No separate 0-120 iBT minimum is published.

aid.notes: President's International Scholarship: $6,000 per year, renewable up to four years, for F-1/J-1 freshmen with 3.5+ GPA (4.0 scale), SAT/ACT/CLT scores and proof of English proficiency; automatic consideration on admission, limited number. Florida Linkage Institute tuition waivers exist for specific countries. International students are not eligible for federal aid.

toefl.note: FAU pages do not print a TOEFL institution code.
